content: संयम् €1 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To restrain, curb, check, control, govern, subdue (<ab>Ātm.</ab>) (as passions <ab>&c.</ab>); असंयतात्मनो योगो दुष्प्राप इति मे मतिः <ls>Bg. 6. 36</ls>; <ls>Ms. 2. 100</ls>. .²2 To bind, imprison, fasten, confine; वानरं मा न संयसीः <ls>Bk. 9. 50</ls>; <ls>M. 1. 7</ls>; <ls>R. 3. 20</ls>, <ls n="R. 3.">42</ls>. .²3 To gather (<ab>Ātm.</ab>); व्रीहीन् संयच्छते <ls>Sk.</ls> .²4 To shut, close; सर्वद्वाराणि संयम्य मनो हृदि निरुध्य च <ls>Bg. 8. 12</ls>. .²5 To hold together, hold fast. .²6 To guide or drive (as horses). .²7 .³({%a%}) To collect. .³({%b%}) To bind or tie into a knot (as hair); संयम्यमानशिखण्डः <ls>V. 5</ls>. .²8 To keep in order. .²9 To present with, give to. .²10 To press close to or against; <ls>Suśr.</ls>
